label: FY2026-27 adopted budget

funds.name: General Fund
funds.note: Day-to-day county government — courthouse, elected offices, animal shelter, contributions.

funds.name: Road Fund
funds.note: County roads, bridges, paving, and the road department.

funds.name: Jail Fund
funds.note: Operating the county jail — staff, inmate care, medical, food, utilities.

funds.name: Auto Insurance Tax
funds.note: Insurance premium tax dedicated to roads and bridges.

funds.name: E-911 Fund
funds.note: Emergency dispatch — 911 fees and the statewide wireless charge.

funds.name: Jail Grant Fund
funds.note: Grant funds held for the jail (largely a certificate of deposit).

funds.name: Co. Clerk Storage Fee
funds.note: Records-storage fee revenue and clerk software/support.

funds.name: Jail Construction Fund
funds.note: Legacy jail-construction account (small ad valorem and carryover).

funds.name: Opioid Settlement
funds.note: Opioid litigation settlement funds (held and transferred).

funds.name: L.G.E.A.
funds.note: Local Government Economic Assistance — mineral-severance share, to roads.

funds.name: ARPA
funds.note: Federal pandemic-relief fund — no activity budgeted this year.

lines.name: Fire protection — CC Fire Rescue Squad

source: Calloway County Fiscal Court adopted budget FY2026-27 (uniform DLG budget form).
